headline: Second reading of High School application to the state for school consolidation, plus middle school design study update.
summary: The agenda includes a second reading of the application to submit school consolidation to the State Department of Education. It also covers a middle school design update, an elementary network briefing, and a postponed vote on a contract with the Portland Administrators Association.
items: Public comment on items not on the agenda
Personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, and other hires
Finance, Personnel and Operations Committee report
Curriculum and Student Success Committee report
Public and Legislative Affairs Committee report
Middle school design study update, with resolution
Foundation for Portland Public Schools quarter one report
High School state application second read: submit application for school consolidation to the State Department of Education
Postponed: adoption of collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association
Executive session to discuss confidential student records
location: Casco Bay High School and via Zoom
